[Trigger: Immediately After Damage] This is used when damage is dealt via [Weapon Attack] with this weapon. It gives [Vulnerability (Physical Damage):7] to the target of the attack. 1Once per scene. A massive warhammer wielded by the Minotaur Champion, refined to be usable by an Adventurer. Its overwhelming mass can easily crush an enemy's scales or armor upon direct impact.
